req.title: Reject non-positive redirect count
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the redirect count is zero or negative.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/<n> must return HTTP 400 when n <= 0. The violation was that test[4] (test_redirect_large_negative_returns_400) had kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that negative kind tests must not use EP heuristic. Fix: change heuristic for that test from EP to NEG, which is the correct heuristic for negative/invalid input testing. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_returns_400
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /redirect/0 using Flask test client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: redirect count of zero must be rejected with HTTP 400
BVA: n=0 is the exact boundary value where n>0 becomes false
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_redirect_zero_returns_400():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/redirect/0')
    assert r.status_code == 400

test_redirect_zero_returns_400()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_redirect_one_returns_302():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/redirect/1')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert 'Location' in r.headers

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_not_2xx_not_3xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /redirect/0 using Flask test client
Check that status code is exactly 400 and not in 2xx or 3xx range
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: n=0 must yield 400, not any success or redirect code
DT: decision table row where n<=0 maps to HTTP 400 error response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_redirect_zero_not_2xx_not_3xx():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/redirect/0')
    assert r.status_code == 400
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 201

test_redirect_zero_not_2xx_not_3xx()
